description: Full intelligence dump on ONE model — what it's good at, what it's bad at, syntax quirks, hidden gotchas, community tips. Read this BEFORE recommending a model the user hasn't used. Saves you from suggesting Suno v4 when they wanted instrumental-only (it can't), Midjourney for transparent PNGs (no), Flux for inpainting (limited), etc. One call beats 10 trial generations.
